profile.description:
Grok Imagine Video 1.5 supports text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-to-video generation with up to seven reference images for consistent characters, up to 15 seconds at 1080p.

Notes:
- Attach 2 to 7 images to keep those characters consistent in a new scene, up to 720p. Refer to them in your prompt as <IMAGE_1>, <IMAGE_2>, and so on

This bot supports optional parameters for additional customization.

rate_cards.rateMenuMarkdown:
**Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Pricing**

Text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-to-video. Billed per second of video generated, by resolution, plus a per-image fee for each image you attach. Text-to-video attaches no images, so it has no image fee.

| Resolution | Rate (USD) | Rate (Points) |
|------------|------------|---------------|
| 480P | $0.096/sec | 3,200 pts/sec |
| 720P | $0.168/sec | 5,600 pts/sec |
| 1080P | $0.300/sec | 10,000 pts/sec |
| Image input | $0.050/image | 1,667 pts/image |
